title: CT-MRI pairs: extremity soft-tissue sarcoma
description: Two Soft-tissue-Sarcoma patients, each with a diagnostic MR study (axial T1 and axial T2 fat-saturated or STIR) and the CT component of an FDG PET/CT, plus the source RTSTRUCT tumour contours (GTV_Mass, GTV_Edema) delineated separately on CT, T1 and T2FS/STIR. CT and MR are linked only as 'independent' same-patient series: no registration is provided or implied.

referenceTargets.teachingNote: Radiotherapy/radiomics target-volume contours from the Soft-tissue-Sarcoma collection, named 'GTV_Mass' and 'GTV_Edema' by the source (RTROIInterpretedType GTV). This contour set references the CT series only. They are target definitions for RT/radiomics, not anatomical teaching boundaries, and the source supplies separate contour sets per series: do not assume the CT and MR contours were drawn independently or that the series are registered (no registration is provided in this pack).
